scope: checkpoint3 Web; source inspection only, not formal delivery review or browser evidence
disposition: Integrated into serialized Web remediation; verification pending

findings.evidence: src/componentes/CadastroNumero.tsx invalidate(), iniciar(), SDK effect dependencies
findings.problem: Reservation clears sdkReady after SDK loaded; unchanged effect dependencies leave the Meta authorization button disabled.
findings.required_proof: Real-backend browser reserves official attempt, then enabled button synchronously invokes provider SDK port from click.

findings.evidence: CadastroNumero confirmar() expects direct TentativaNumero; NumberRegistrationService.confirm() returns {registration: DTO}, controller forwards it
findings.problem: Successful confirmation replaces attempt with a wrapper lacking id/state, breaking stage rendering and subsequent actions.
findings.required_proof: Real BFF confirmation renders pending receipt and advances correct persisted attempt.

findings.problem: Close automatically cancels durable partial registration; reload has no resume path.
findings.required_proof: Close/reload resumes authorized partial attempt with server options; no secret persisted. Pending authorization without nonce exposes deliberate safe restart.

findings.evidence: Numeros polls only BU list; CadastroNumero only GETs attempt immediately after pair/actions
findings.problem: Webhook progression updates channel projection while wizard attempt remains stale.
findings.required_proof: Normal provider webhook advances displayed current attempt; old response cannot update after close/BU switch/unmount.

findings.evidence: CadastroNumero iniciar() creates crypto.randomUUID() for every submit
findings.problem: Response-loss retry of same atomic new-BU registration gets a new idempotency key and can duplicate the reservation intent.
findings.required_proof: Drop first real BFF response after commit; same intent retries same key and returns one BU/channel/attempt. Changed intent gets fresh key.

findings.evidence: MetaHttpClient.recursos(token,wabaId,after) returns selected WABA only; carregarOpcoes replaces entire options
findings.problem: Loading numbers removes the other authorized WABA choices.
findings.required_proof: Multi-WABA browser selection can load and switch WABA without accepting stale numbers/cursor.

additional_probe: SDK callback must be generation/attempt correlated and duplicate popup blocked; bounded JSON-string/object messages must reject malformed/untrusted origin without logging payload. Meta primary SDK page retrieval returned429; no real-SDK certification claimed.
remaining_gates: Real-backend Playwright, FRC/BCI, independent delivery/security/adherence/test quality reviews, runtime and external provider evidence.
